title: The Electronic Catalogue
purpose: A department store shows three goods and takes an order with one key press.
style: Saturated primaries on navy, bold flat product drawings with price tags

title: Your Balance, Mrs Okafor
purpose: A home bank swings its vault door open on a customer's balances and paid bills.
style: Wheat gold and prairie green, foreshortened steel vault door

title: Build Your Credit
purpose: A savings and loan advertisement that stacks coins into a staircase, climbs it and only then says its slogan.
style: Royal blue sky, gold coin stacks, a flat figure climbing

title: The Showhome on Cedar Crescent
purpose: A realty listing that lets a buyer see a house, its floor plan and its mortgage without leaving home.
style: Brick and cream listing sheet with a house elevation and a labelled plan

title: Classifieds: Bicycles
purpose: A neighbourhood classified column on screen, with a drawn ten-speed on top and one advertisement flagged for the reader.
style: Slate board with an orange masthead, a bright ten-speed and a blinking cyan ad

title: Going Once, Going Twice
purpose: A live electronic auction counts a rising bid on seven-segment digits while the lot, an antique clock, waits.
style: Burgundy salesroom, brass clock in arcs, amber seven-segment bid counter

title: Grocery Order, Week of June 3
purpose: A corner grocer takes a weekly order: each item drops into a wire cart and the running total follows.
style: Fresh mint, cream and grocer green with flat-colour packages in a wire cart

title: Theatre Tickets
purpose: A box office opens its curtain, shows the hall with sold and free seats, and holds the reader's chosen pair.
style: Red velvet and brass on black, a pleated curtain that opens, a seat plan in small squares

title: The Mall Directory
purpose: A shopping-centre kiosk page: two floor plans in pastel, numbered stores, a blinking YOU ARE HERE and a column of touch targets.
style: Navy kiosk with pastel store blocks and bevelled touch keys

title: Today's Special at the Hardware Store
purpose: A late-videotex page whose advertising band at the foot opens into a full-screen advertisement with a SALE starburst that cycles colour.
style: Hazard yellow and charcoal, a large cordless drill, a three-layer starburst chasing through the colour map
